title: Show Git operations in the Edge terminal
acceptance: Every Git and GitHub command in an Edge session runs in the OpenCode terminal tab with a visible work-item banner, and the lifecycle skill documents the naming, stacked-PR and commit-trailer rules.
evidence: PR #6 carries this work as part of PI-1: https://github.com/chakibelbassam/FoundationOS/pull/6. Adds the OpenCode terminal skill and driver, Show-GitContext.ps1, Work-Item and Agent trailers, stacked-PR rules and the visible-execution rule. Verified: driver tests 8/8, npm test 12/12, and every Git step ran in the terminal tab.
